The '''Sayormi Soulstinger''' was a [[Sayormi]] melee weapon developed for the personal use of the [[Sayormi Queen]]. Capable of destroying armors, it was more powerful than the [[Sayormi Heartstriker/Legends|Sayormi Heartstriker]].<ref name="SWG:SS" />
{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Sayormi Soulstinger was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Sayormi Soulstinger was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:SS" />
